questions.title: What is Achology?
questions.short_answer: An online applied psychology academy: 28 courses across seven schools, a community, and certification.

questions.title: Is Achology accredited?
questions.short_answer: Yes, by SoMAP, whose committee of Master Achologists checks every claim on the accreditation pathway.

questions.title: Who is Kain Ramsay?
questions.short_answer: Achology's founder and principal teacher, whose applied psychology courses began on Udemy.

questions.title: Who is Achology designed for?
questions.short_answer: Reflective, self-directed adults: helpers, professionals, and people learning for their own growth.

questions.title: How do Achology courses work?
questions.short_answer: Self-paced videos, reflective exercises, community practice, and included membership months.
questions.status: kept; takes the new title from the review file's item 1

questions.title: What does Achology membership include?
questions.short_answer: Daily live events, peer practice, mentorship groups, and discussion spaces for $34.50 a month.

questions.title: How long do Achology courses take to complete?
questions.short_answer: Weeks for a Masterclass, months for practitioner study, all self-paced with no deadlines.

questions.title: Where should I start with Achology?
questions.short_answer: Free events to try it, a course for a clear goal, membership to explore: match the start to you.

questions.title: How much does Achology cost?
questions.short_answer: Courses run $97 to $299, school bundles $987 to $1,337, and the Access All Areas Pass is $2,995.

questions.title: Does Achology offer a money-back guarantee?
questions.short_answer: Yes, a full 14-day guarantee covers courses, bundles, and the Pass; membership is the exception.

questions.title: Can I pay for Achology courses in instalments?
questions.short_answer: Yes: you can pay in full or spread the cost over monthly instalments, and the checkout shows the options for each course, bundle and pass.

questions.title: How do I request a refund from Achology?
questions.short_answer: Email support@achology.com with your order number, purchase date, product name, and account email.
